baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا joins forward-looking expectation, Godward direction, and dignified gravity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Expectation is relationally directed: what is missing is not bare knowledge of God but an anticipatory stance in which God is accorded reverent gravity.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope supplies the forward-looking orientation whose absence the negation questions.
Worship and the worshipped one make God the proper recipient and organizing object of the orientation.
Dignified gravity and reverence specify the weighty regard that expectation should yield.

changed_reading.before: A flat rebuke meaning only, 'Why do you not respect God?'
changed_reading.after: A rebuke of failed orientation: why does what you anticipate not make God gravely present in your regard?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَرْجُونَ can look toward an outcome while وَقَارًا can carry the material image of a borne weight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can probe practical reckoning: God has not been assigned enough prospective weight to alter how the addressees estimate outcomes and act.

activation_trace.role: Expectation supplies anticipation of an outcome rather than hope as a merely pleasant feeling.
The worshipped one identifies whose reality should carry decisive weight in the reckoning.
A heavy carried load materializes waqar as consequential weight that changes movement.

changed_reading.before: Waqar names only an inward or ceremonial respect.
changed_reading.after: Waqar is the effective weight God has in one's forecast of reality; their conduct shows that weight is missing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Godward prepositional phrase stands between expectation and a وَقَار branch of settling and stillness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Expectation should settle into a stable devotional posture. The failure challenged by the verse is volatility: God has not become a fixed center around which conduct rests.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope supplies the moving orientation that ought to arrive at a stable posture.
Devotion to the worshipped one gives the settling its Godward center.
Settling or sitting turns reverence from passing affect into durable placement.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks for a momentary feeling of awe.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks why expectation has not settled into a durable God-centered posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning precedes an approaching painful outcome and a fixed endpoint. That temporal chain broadens expectation from hoped-for benefit to sober anticipation, while waqar becomes the weight of a consequence already bearing on present conduct.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope provides the focus anchor but expands here into anticipation of either pleasing or feared arrival.
The heavy load gives the anticipated outcome present behavioral weight.
Warning that awakens caution establishes anticipation as the intended practical response.
Coming and arrival supply the directional movement from warning toward realized outcome.
Pain and punishment identify the feared outcome that expectation must take seriously.
A fixed limit of time closes indefinite postponement and gives the warning a hard horizon.

structural_cues: 71:1 orders warning before an arriving painful punishment, and 71:4 repeats the appointed limit as non-negotiable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, arrival, pain, a fixed term, expectation, and weight; I infer that the temporal chain converts waqar into prospective consequence. A live alternative is that the chain only intensifies ordinary reverence without changing the sense of expectation.

changed_reading.before: Why do you not hope for or show reverence to God?
changed_reading.after: Why do you not reckon forward to God with enough gravity that the approaching outcome already weighs on you?

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated calls to worship, take protection, and obey make waqar operational. Its test is embodied allegiance, with forgiveness as the hoped-for protective result, not respectful language left behaviorally inert.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope supplies the desired outcome toward which the commanded posture moves.
Worship and the worshipped one anchor reverence in devotional allegiance.
Dignified reverence names the orientation whose practical content the commands disclose.
Submissive worship turns regard into enacted devotion.
Placing oneself within protection gives the posture a self-implicating, precautionary function.
Compliance and obedience make conduct the observable measure of reverence.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer supplies the hoped-for result of that allegiance.

structural_cues: 71:3 coordinates three imperatives, and 71:4 immediately states their protective result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command sequence and forgiveness after it; I infer that these commands unpack what Godward waqar does. The alternative is that they are separate duties and the focus later asks only about inward estimation.

changed_reading.before: Waqar is respectful estimation of God.
changed_reading.after: Waqar is the gravity that becomes worship, precaution, and obedience because forgiveness is genuinely expected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressees manufacture heaviness at the auditory gate through blocking, covering, persistence, and self-magnification. The ear-heaviness branch of waqar creates a sharp reversal: weight is present, but as deafening resistance rather than Godward reverence.

activation_trace.role: Heaviness in the ear supplies the literal counter-image of blocked reception.
Dignified gravity names the Godward form into which auditory heaviness fails to be converted.
Listening and accepting define the receptive channel that the source scene deliberately closes.
A covering laid over something extends refusal from the ear into bodily concealment.
Persistence and resolve make the blockage a maintained stance rather than an accidental failure to hear.
Magnifying something in the breast directs gravity toward the self as a rival center.

structural_cues: 71:7 stages fingers in ears, garments drawn over bodies, persistence, and self-magnification in one escalating refusal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obstructed ear scene and both auditory-heaviness and reverence branches of the focus root; I infer a deliberate misplaced-weight contrast. The live alternative is lexical resonance without a designed semantic reversal.

changed_reading.before: They simply lack reverence for God.
changed_reading.after: They enact the wrong waqar: heaviness seals hearing and enlarges the self instead of becoming reverent gravity toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness opens into abundant rain, connected increase, wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers. The focus then interrupts the gift cascade and tests its direction: expectancy that terminates in goods has not matured into gravity toward the giver.

activation_trace.role: Expectant hope receives concrete desirable objects from the immediately preceding sequence.
The worshipped one redirects desire from the benefits to their divine source.
Reverent gravity is the transformation by which desire for gifts becomes regard for the giver.
Protective covering of sin begins the promised-benefit sequence with restored standing.
Abundant outflow from its source gives the promise a cascading material force.
Connected increase that extends support ties the several gifts into sustained provision.
Possessing and multiplying wealth supplies an immediate object of human hope.
Sonship and lineage supply hoped-for continuity beyond material possession.
A garden enclosed by trees gives abundance a habitable and protective form.
Flowing rivers complete the image of durable fertility and provision.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 forms a crescendo of pardon, water, assets, descendants, gardens, and rivers; 71:13 immediately pivots from those gifts to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the benefit crescendo and the abrupt Godward question; I infer that the question tests whether hope stops at goods or acquires reverent direction. The alternative is that the goods simply demonstrate divine power and generosity without critiquing transactional hope.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are faulted for not hoping that God will give them good things.
changed_reading.after: They are faulted because even hope for pardon and abundance has not made God, rather than the goods, the weighty center of desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation unfolds through successive human states, superposed cosmic layers, growth from earth, return, and emergence. Waqar therefore gains cumulative and structural weight: reverence is the settled conclusion of observing an ordered process with a future trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Expectation opens the observed developmental pattern toward its still-future completion.
A borne load renders the many observations as accumulating evidential weight.
Settling and stillness supply the stable posture into which accumulated evidence should resolve.
Measuring and proportioning make creation an ordered process rather than an unexplained fact.
Successive states give the process temporal articulation and cumulative force.
Layers placed above one another turn order into a visible cosmic architecture.
Human growth and nurture connect cosmic order to the addressees' own development.
Return after departure bends development into a cycle with an accountable horizon.
Passage to the outside supplies the cycle's decisive emergence and future completion.

structural_cues: 71:14-18 moves from personal stages to layered heavens, earthly growth, return, and renewed emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured making, stages, layers, growth, return, and emergence; I infer that their ordered sequence accumulates the focus word's weight and stabilizes expectation. The alternative is a simpler evidential list supporting divine greatness without a process model.

changed_reading.before: God should be revered because creation is impressive.
changed_reading.after: The ordered process already carrying them through stages, return, and emergence should accumulate enough weight to settle their future-facing regard on God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group follows a socially powerful figure whose wealth and offspring increase only loss, then collectively protects named cult objects. Waqar is not absent as a human capacity; it is misallocated to status, lineage, and rival objects of worship.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one marks God as the proper center against which rival allegiances are measured.
Weight supplies a transferable economy of importance that can be placed on the wrong center.
Honor and magnification name the regard being diverted from God.
Allegiance and serial following provide the social conduit through which misplaced gravity spreads.
Accumulated wealth supplies one visible basis for the followed figure's social weight.
Offspring and descent add lineage and continuity to that rival prestige.
General diminution exposes the apparent increase in status and assets as an actual loss.
Objects treated as worshipped recipients make the rival allocation of reverence explicit.
The named idol concretizes one recipient to which communal attachment assigns cultic weight.

structural_cues: 71:21-23 moves from following a person marked by wealth and offspring to a collective command not to abandon inherited gods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, social assets, resulting loss, and defended cult objects; I infer a transfer of waqar from God to social and ritual rivals. The alternative is that these are later examples of disobedience rather than the mechanism behind the focus question.

changed_reading.before: They possess too little capacity for reverence.
changed_reading.after: They possess and distribute gravity, but wealth, lineage, leaders, and inherited gods receive the weight that should orient them toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deferral branch of the focus root lets refusal appear as postponing the divine claim. The closing sequence answers that posture with engulfment, forced entry into fire, absent support, and terminal breaking; delayed regard does not delay the weight of outcome.

activation_trace.role: Deferring something to a later time supplies the exploratory image of postponing recognition.
A heavy load supplies the consequence whose force remains despite attempted postponement.
Total engulfment removes room for continued evasion.
Entry into an interior marks transition from threatened outcome to an enclosing realized state.
Kindled fire identifies the realized state into which the sequence moves them.
Aid and vindication, explicitly unavailable in the source scene, close the possibility of external escape.
Destruction, invalidation, and breaking give the trajectory a terminal image.

structural_cues: 71:25 compresses drowning, entry, fire, and failed help into a rapid sequence; 71:28 ends with an intensifying destruction formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch of deferral and a later irreversible sequence; I infer that refusal functions as attempted postponement and that the ending closes it. The live alternative is that the deferral branch is too form-distant and the ending only confirms the baseline consequence model.

changed_reading.before: Their failure of reverence can remain indefinitely unresolved.
changed_reading.after: Their non-recognition behaves like postponement, but the closing sequence makes the deferred divine weight arrive as an inescapable outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant م ر ج mapping for the verbal focus root rather than the dominant hope branch. It remains anchored by that explicit split mapping, by وَقَارًا as settling, and by later following into misguidance. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary resonance of unstable orientation, never as the lexical translation of تَرْجُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The source root ر ج و is explicitly split to a م ر ج inventory of confused looseness, while focus وَقَارًا has a settling branch.

activation_trace.role: Confusion and disorder supply an exploratory image of an orientation whose commitments are mixed.
A thing wobbling loose in its place supplies the spatial behavior of failed spiritual placement.
Settling or sitting supplies the stable counter-state that Godward waqar would provide.
Allegiance through serial following shows unstable orientation being captured by another direction.
Deviation from guidance gives the wobble a directional consequence.

changed_reading.before: They do not entertain sufficient hope or expectation.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory echo, they remain loose and disordered in orientation because no Godward gravity has settled them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the near-delivery branch is a remote material image within ر ج و, not the ordinary sense of the focus verb. It remains anchored by the focus root inventory, the heavy-load branch of وَقَارًا, and the context's stages, human growth, and birth. Downstream prose should label it a gestational analogy for ripening consequence, not a proposed gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs a ر ج و branch of pregnancy nearing delivery with a وَقَار branch of a carried heavy load.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy nearing delivery supplies a process carrying an outcome toward emergence.
A heavy borne load makes the developing outcome materially consequential before it appears.
Completion and proportion of created form give the carried process a shaping logic.
Successive stages supply the temporal development between carrying and issue.
Human growth and nurture extend the development image to the addressees themselves.
The event of birth supplies the eventual issue of what has been carried through stages.

changed_reading.before: Expectation concerns an abstract future possibility.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the outcome is already being carried through stages and gaining weight before its eventual emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nominal 'edge or side' branch of ر ج و against a verbal occurrence normally read as expectation. It remains anchored by the packet branch and by the following spatial sequence of heavens, layers, spread earth, traversing, and open passes, paired with وَقَارًا as settling. Downstream prose should retain it only as a spatial echo in which divine gravity orders a field, not as syntax-level translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch images the side or edge of a thing, while another focus branch images settling; the following ayat construct a layered and traversable spatial field.

activation_trace.role: The side or edge of a thing supplies the field's margins as the exploratory focus echo.
Settling supplies a stable center or placement within the expanded field.
Heaven and what rises overhead establish the field's upper extent.
Superposed layers articulate ordered depth between the field's bounds.
The lower ground opposite heaven establishes the field's lower extent.
Spreading and extension open the lower field for movement.
Penetrating along a path turns ordered space into directed traversal.
A wide open pass supplies channels through the field rather than undifferentiated expanse.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only an inward estimate of divine dignity.
changed_reading.after: As a spatial resonance, Godward gravity is what would settle orientation within a world of margins, layers, and traversable paths.

strongest_changes: The blocked-ear scene reverses وَقَار from reverent gravity into deliberately manufactured auditory heaviness.
The promise cascade makes the focus a test of whether hope stops at goods or turns toward the giver.
Stages, layers, growth, return, and emergence make waqar cumulative evidential weight rather than a static honorific.
Following wealth, offspring, leaders, and named gods reveals gravity as misallocated rather than absent.
The closing consequence sequence gives the focus's deferral branch an exploratory answer: postponed regard does not postpone outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The rare focus root inventory supports a compact set of linked transformations: hope becomes reckoning, honor becomes effective weight and settled conduct, auditory heaviness becomes a reversal, and the explicit split mapping preserves a controlled instability reading. The immediate location between promised abundance and staged creation makes the Godward direction of expectation more important than a generic call for respect.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا permits a live range among hope, expectation, and practical reckoning; the packet does not force one English rendering.
The weight, settling, and ear-heaviness branches may function as contextual resonance rather than intended senses of وَقَارًا.
The non-dominant م ر ج mapping and the gestational and edge images are explicitly branch-backed but form-distant, so they should remain qualified outliers.
